title: Integrality (I): the limit of smooth push-forwards of an integer multiplicity current is integer multiplicity (supplied step 7)
statement: Assume, as hypotheses, (CB) the frozen type of Submission.cmcdt_lp_covector_norm_bounds, and (VO), (MR), (IMC), (IMS) exactly as in the selected statement (the frozen types of dtc_vanish_off_support, cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure, cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub and cmcdt_im_series, as antecedents). Then conclusion (I) of the selected statement holds. Let N, N', k ∈ ℕ, Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, F : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} Λ-Lipschitz, X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N) integer multiplicity with compact support and M(X) < ∞, and S ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^{N'}). Suppose there are C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)) Λ-Lipschitz maps F_j : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} converging to F uniformly on ℝ^N such that, for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N'}), there are test forms η_j ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^N), each equal to F_j^#ω (x ↦ ω(F_j(x)) ∘ DF_j(x)) on some open set containing spt X, with X(η_j) → S(ω). Then S is integer multiplicity.
